sources.title: Brother FAQ: パソコンでNC言語のプログラム作成をしたい (writing an NC-language program on a PC)
Brother FAQ: クーラントがオフのとき加工プログラムを起動しないようにしたい (macro example program)
Brother FAQ: プログラムを実行するとワーク座標原点の値が変わってしまう (G10 L2/L20)
Brother FAQ: ワーク座標原点をG54-G59の6カ所以上に設定したい (G54.1 P1-P48)
Brother FAQ: レファレンス点復帰指令時の座標を変えたい (CNC-C00) (G28/G30)
Brother FAQ: タップ加工で指令不可Gコード SM4001 (M140X1/M140X2/M200X3/M300X3; contains a reference program)
Brother FAQ: SM4006 指令不可数値データエラー (malformed number)
Brother FAQ: 同期タップ戻し機能の無い機械でタップ復旧動作をしたい (G133/G134)
Brother CNC-D00 product page, NC Unit Specifications
Brother FAQ: プログラムの途中から動作させたい (CNC-D00) (restart by sequence number)

program_open.value: Program named O + 4 digits (e.g. O0001); file saved with extension .nc
program_open.note: No statement found on a leading % or an O line inside the file; FAQ examples show '(O1001)' as a parenthesised title (S2). '%' marks: UNKNOWN.

program_close.value: M30, and the M30 block must itself be terminated (Enter -> EOB)

comment.value: Parentheses: (text). Japanese comments need the file saved as ANSI (Shift-JIS), not UTF-8
comment.where: p1 example program; S1 p1 for encoding
comment.note: Semicolon is the EOB character, not a comment (S1). Safe choice: ASCII text in ( ).

line_numbers.value: N words allowed (e.g. N1000 as a GOTO target); restart can be by sequence number or by block count 'B30'
line_numbers.note: S11 p1-2 for restart by sequence number. Required/maximum digits: UNKNOWN.

block_end.value: Newline in the PC file; becomes ';' (EOB) on the control

safe_start.value: Accepted in one block in a Brother reference program: G54 G0 G90 G17 G97 G94 G98 ;
safe_start.note: Example is for M-series (milling-turning) models. G21/G71, G40, G49, G80: UNKNOWN (not in any open Brother document fetched). CNC-D00 lists inch/metric switching and cutter compensation as functions (S10) without codes.

tool_change.value: G100 T<n> ... (Brother tool-change G code, in a block that also carries positioning, G43 H and S/M words), e.g. G100T2G94X0Y-10.A0.C0G43H2Z70.M141G97;
tool_change.note: Seen only in an M-series example. M6: UNKNOWN (memory says M06 Tnn is also accepted, unverified). D word: UNKNOWN.

tool_length_comp.value: G43 H<n> with a Z move (e.g. G43H1Z30.)
tool_length_comp.note: Tool length offsets are measured into the tool list (FAQ tset-001-008). G49: UNKNOWN.

spindle.note: M3/M4/M5: UNKNOWN in open docs. S7 shows M-series-specific M141/M142/M303, not general milling codes.

work_offset.value: G54-G59 (6), plus extended G54.1 P1..P48 (48); set by program with G10 L2 P_ (G54-G59) and G10 L20 P_ (G54.1)
work_offset.note: S3 p1 for G10 L2/L20. Also external work offset and macro system variables (S3).

feed.value: F word; G94 feed per minute, G95 feed per revolution both appear (F1000 with G94 mode, F0.05 with G95)
feed.note: Unit (mm/min under G94) is the usual meaning and is consistent with F1000 / F0.05 values, but no sentence states it: treat as inferred.

decimal_point.value: A value with two decimal points (X100.0.) raises SM4006; values written with a point (Z30., X10.0). Meaning of a value without a point (X10 = 10 mm or 10 um): UNKNOWN
decimal_point.note: Post should always emit a decimal point.

max_digits.value: Least input increment 0.001 mm (0.0001 inch, 0.001 deg); max programmable dimension +/-999999.999 mm (+/-99999.9999 inch) -> 6.3 format
max_digits.note: CNC-D00 figure; CNC-C00 not checked in an open source.

retract_home.value: G28 X_ Y_ Z_ (A_ B_ C_) returns to the reference point; G30 P2..P6 X_ Y_ Z_ to the 2nd-6th reference point (P omitted = 2nd)
retract_home.note: S6 p1 same for CNC-D00. Whether the G28 coordinates are an intermediate point, and the G91 G28 Z0 idiom: not stated -> keep UNKNOWN for that form. G53: UNKNOWN.

coolant.value: M8 coolant on appears in a reference program

rigid_tap_G84.note: G84 not found. Brother-specific seen instead: G77 Z_ R_ I<pitch> S_ (tapping, M-series example); G133/G134 Z_ I<pitch mm> | J<threads/inch> S_ synchronised tap forward/reverse (G134 = back-out of right-hand thread). What F means in G84: UNKNOWN. Do not map G84 onto G77 without the manual.

return_level.value: G98 is accepted in a start-of-program modal block
return_level.note: Its meaning (initial-level return) is not stated in the source; G99: UNKNOWN.

native_language.value: Two program formats: NC language (G-code) and conversation (Brother conversational), switched by parameter; a conversation program can be converted to an NC-language program. Macro (#vars, IF..GOTO, #3000 alarm) in NC mode

notes: No Brother NC programming/instruction manual is openly downloadable: the manual ships with the machine and the machinetool.global.brother download portal (bilim.my.salesforce-sites.com) is for catalogs and returned 503 'CatalogInMaintenance'. All values come from Brother's own published FAQ PDFs (download.brother.com/pub/jp/machine/pdf/faq/, Japanese) and the CNC-D00 spec page. Several values are only seen inside example programs, mostly from an M-series (mill-turn) FAQ; treat them as 'accepted', not as the full rule. Third-party copies (Scribd 'Brother TC-S2D Programming Manual', eBay listing of a CNC-C00 NC programming manual) noted, not used.
